name: cards-runway

changelog.summary: Added data, accentColor, cardColor, and cardWidth as public props with a working remixer panel. The originally suggested props (cards, speed, gap, perspective, pauseOnHover) didn't match this component's real API, so they were replaced with the props CardsRunway actually accepts.
Desktop pin/scrub threshold raised from >1024px to >=1280px to match the max-[1025px] CSS breakpoint; previously the 1025-1279px range ran the desktop timeline against the collapsed mobile layout.
Added prefers-reduced-motion support: cards render in place instead of animating up from a y offset

title: Cards Runway
description: A horizontal runway of cards that animates as you scroll

default.title: A smarter assistant in your pocket
default.text: AI now drafts your messages, sets your reminders, and answers questions before you finish typing them. What once meant opening five apps is increasingly a single spoken sentence.

default.title: Recommendations that just fit
default.text: The songs you discover, the shows you binge, the products you didn't know you wanted - quietly ranked by models learning your taste. Personalization has become the default, not the feature.

default.title: Language is no longer a wall
default.text: Real-time translation turns menus, road signs, and conversations abroad into something you actually understand. AI is slowly erasing the friction of speaking a different tongue.

default.title: Creativity, on tap
default.text: Write a prompt, get an image, a melody, or a first draft in seconds. AI doesn't replace the spark, it hands more people the tools to act on theirs.

default.title: Everyday coding, accelerated
default.text: From autocompleting a function to explaining an error, AI sits beside developers as a tireless pair. The gap between an idea and a working prototype keeps getting shorter.
